tools.name: create_team

tools.name: get_context

tools.name: get_live_activity

tools.name: get_my_stats

tools.name: get_org_stats

tools.name: get_project_status
tools.description: Get the current status of a project including recent activity. You can use either the project name or ID.

tools.name: get_session_details

tools.name: get_team_details

tools.name: list_notifications

tools.name: list_pending_invites

tools.name: list_positions

tools.name: list_project_members
tools.description: List all members involved in a project. Includes users who have sessions in the project and users from teams linked to the project.

tools.name: list_project_teams
tools.description: List teams linked to a project.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in your organization. No parameters needed — just call it to see all your projects.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List your recent work sessions. Optionally filter by project name or ID. Shows task type, status, and event count.

tools.name: list_sprints
tools.description: List sprints for a project. Shows sprint number, name, goal, status (current/completed), and task count.

tools.name: list_tasks

tools.name: list_teams

tools.name: log_activity

tools.name: log_trace

tools.name: move_task_to_sprint

tools.name: remove_task_dependency

tools.name: remove_team_member
tools.description: Remove a member from a team. Find the team by name or ID, and the user by name or email.

tools.name: remove_user_from_org
tools.description: Remove a user from the current organization without deleting their account. Admin/owner only.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search entities in the knowledge graph by name. Finds people, companies, documents, concepts, tools, etc. that have been mentioned in your activities.

tools.name: set_context_routing
tools.description: Set the context routing mode for the organization. Requires admin role. Options: 'keyword_llm' (balanced), 'keyword_only' (fastest), 'llm_only' (most accurate).

tools.name: setup_organization
tools.description: Set up your organization in one step (admin only). Use this for onboarding.

tools.description: Start a work session. If a project is provided (project_name or project_id), the session is bound to it; if neither is provided, an unbound (projectless) session is created — useful when the work isn't tied to a specific project. tools.description: Unlink a project from a team. Find both by name or ID.

tools.name: update_org
tools.description: Update your organization's details (owner only). Set name, description, business model, objectives, custom context for AI, or links.

tools.name: update_position
tools.description: Update a position's title, description, or permissions (admin only). Find by title or ID.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project's name, description, or links. Find by name or ID.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a task's status, title, description, priority, or team assignment. Use this to move tasks through the workflow (todo -> in_progress -> done) or reassign to a team.

tools.name: update_team
tools.description: Update a team's name, description, or objectives. Find by name or ID.

tools.name: update_user
tools.description: Update an existing user's name, role, positions, or skills (admin/owner only).

tools.name: upload_document
tools.description: Upload a document to the organization's knowledge base. Documents can be templates, policies, contracts, procedures, guides, or references. tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Get your profile, organization, projects, recent sessions, and top entities. This is the best starting point — call this first to understand what's available. No parameters needed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_colleagues, list_notifications, mark_notification_read · Private data: delete_document, find_documents, get_context, get_document, link_task_session, search_entities, upload_document · Public sink: add_team_member, assign_task, list_colleagues, remove_team_member, upload_document · Destructive: delete_document, delete_position, delete_project, delete_task, delete_team, delete_user, remove_task_dependency, remove_team_member, remove_user_from_org, unassign_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_colleagues, list_notifications, mark_notification_read · Private data: delete_document, find_documents, get_context, get_document, link_task_session, search_entities, upload_document · Public sink: add_team_member, assign_task, list_colleagues, remove_team_member, upload_document · Destructive: delete_document, delete_position, delete_project, delete_task, delete_team, delete_user, remove_task_dependency, remove_team_member, remove_user_from_org, unassign_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
